meta.freeride.title: Freeride in Kazakhstan — Snowmobile & Cat Skiing Tours in Ridder, Altai | Asferia
meta.freeride.desc: Freeride tours near Ridder in the Kazakh Altai: utility snowmobile drop-offs (8–10 runs a day) and Formatic-350 cat skiing (5–8 runs a day). All-inclusive tours of 3 riding days and 4 nights with lodging, meals, guide, avalanche gear and banya, from 370,000 KZT. Season mid-November to mid-April.

winter.freeride_cta.p: Snowmobile or snowcat drop-offs. All-inclusive tours of 3 riding days and 4 nights.

items: Every run leads back to the meeting point — there is no way to get lost.
For the whole tour you are surrounded by conifer forest, far from town.
Probe, shovel and transceiver are part of the tour price.

media.sub: Climbs, lines and powder — footage from this season.

items: Near Ridder in the Western Altai, East Kazakhstan. The bases are Klimovka and Vosmyorka. Ridder is 120 km from Ust-Kamenogorsk.
Fly to Ust-Kamenogorsk (Oskemen, UKK) via Almaty or Astana. We arrange the transfer from the airport to the base and back.
A bed in a house at the base, breakfast, lunch box and dinner, a seat on the snowmobile or in the snowcat, a guide, avalanche gear (probe, shovel, transceiver) and banya.
Snowcat tours run with 10 or more, up to 12–14. Snowmobile tours run with 4 or more, up to 6. If there are fewer of you, write to us and we will find an option.
